source.name: Medium Resolution Digital Elevation Model (MRDEM) 30 m, DTM

attribution: Contains information licensed under the Open Government Licence - Canada (NRCan MRDEM).
method: Resampled to 120 m Web Mercator cells (average) and Gaussian smoothed (sigma 1.5 cells). Upland is ground at least 120 m high and 100 m above the lowest ground in a 81-cell window. Marks sit on a jittered 1000 m grid over upland. Decorative relief, not survey data.
